# Quran Studio

> Quran Studio is a free, open-source app to create beautiful Quran recitation videos. Pick a reciter, style the verses, export in HD.

Quran Studio is a web and desktop-ready editor for creating Quran recitation videos. It combines Quran text, translations, timed recitation audio, typography controls, and visual backgrounds into an exportable MP4 canvas workflow.

- Site: https://quranstudio.cyou
- Web app: https://app.quranstudio.cyou
- GitHub: https://github.com/DashingMZA/quran-studio
- Releases: https://github.com/DashingMZA/quran-studio/releases
- License: GPL-3.0 (https://github.com/DashingMZA/quran-studio/blob/master/LICENSE)

## Pages

- [Home](https://quranstudio.cyou): Create beautiful Quran recitation videos in minutes.
- [Features](https://quranstudio.cyou/features): Verse-accurate syncing, Arabic typography, Urdu translation, backgrounds, HD MP4 export.
- [How It Works](https://quranstudio.cyou/how-it-works): Pick verses → choose reciter → style → export.
- [Download](https://quranstudio.cyou/download): Windows (.exe/.msi), macOS (.dmg Apple Silicon/Intel), Linux (.AppImage/.deb/.rpm). Free, no account needed.
- [FAQ](https://quranstudio.cyou/faq): Frequently asked questions.
